ios.desc:
OVinfo gives you current travel information for the entire public transport system in the Netherlands. The app shows how long you have to wait before you can board, indicates where the current position of the vehicle and uses reliable information about the  accessibility at stations and stops.

The app was developed with special attention to accessibility: all information about barrier-free boarding is also accessible barrier-free. On both iPhone and iPad, all buttons are spoken by VoiceOver and dynamic font size has been tested with visually impaired users.

OVapi B.V. has been giving up-to-date travel information for nearly 10 years and receives the data via ND-OV (National Data Public Transport) directly from all carriers in the Netherlands, including Arriva, Breng, Bravo, Connexxion, EBS, GVB, Hermes, HTM, RRReis, Overal, NS, RET, Keolis en U-OV

android.desc: 🇳🇱 The complete public transport app for the Netherlands With OV Informatie, you always have up-to-date departure times, delays, and real-time vehicle positions for trains, buses, trams and metro services throughout the Netherlands. Fast, reliable and easy to use — your perfect travel companion for Dutch public transport. 🚆 All-in-one public transport app Whether you travel with NS, GVB, RET, Arriva, Qbuzz, Connexxion or any other operator, this app puts all travel information in one place: 📍 Live departure times for every stop or station 🕒 Real-time delays and vehicle positions 🚉 Overview of service disruptions and cancelled trips 🗺️ Easily find nearby stops 🔍 Quick search by line number, stop or operator 🚍 Supported transport operators All public transport providers in the Netherlands are included: NS, Arriva, Qbuzz / U-OV, Connexxion (CXX), Transdev, Hermes, Breng, GVB (Amsterdam), HTM (The Hague region), RET (Rotterdam), Syntus / Keolis, EBS, RRReis, NMBS and DB. 💡 Why choose OV Informatie? Independent app – not affiliated with any transport company Official and up-to-date data from all operators Clean and fast interface Works on all Android devices 💬 Frequently Asked Questions Why are there ads? We’re a small, independent developer. Ads help us cover the costs of development and servers. You can remove ads with a small in-app purchase. Why can’t I see real-time info for my bus? Some buses (especially local or “buurtbussen”) don’t have tracking systems. In other cases, there may be temporary outages or route deviations. If a trip is officially cancelled, this will be clearly shown in the app. Other questions or feedback? Feel free to email us at ovinfo@ovapi.nl – we’re happy to help!

quotes.text:
These are also worth a mention:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=nl.skywave.ovinfo / https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/ovinfo/id1144468923

https://drgl.nl/

https://www.rijdendetreinen.nl/

https://spoorkaart.mwnn.nl/

I use the dutch version of this (OVInfo: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=nl.skywave.ovinfo ) which does have a nicer interface: You _can_ load a map and gawk at it, but by default it loads very fast and shows a list of stops/stations in order of how close they are, and clicking on them shows the up-to-the-minute (in some regions, up-to-the-second) exact departure times including any current delays.

In an public transport heavy region (lots of The Netherlands is PT heavy) this changes how you interact with public transport. You stop planning. You decide you want to go to X, so you walk to the nearest stop you know will take you to X (in contrast to someone who rarely uses PT or lives in a PT light area: They either don't know the routes and thus don't know which stop to walk to, or there is only one stop within walking distance if that), and as you walk, it takes all of about 5 seconds, literally, to know if you should walk briskly or have time for a detour or whatever. Or even check if a different stop would be more efficient.

It's powered by the same data. 'look, a map!' is visually the most interesting, and thus perhaps appropriate here, where I would assume most readers don't even live in Belgium.
quotes.story_title: Live map of public transport in Belgium
